summary: Idaho Copper Corp filed an 8-K regarding a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 3,712,000 common shares and warrants at $4.85 per unit, raising ~$18 million. ThinkEquity is the underwriter with a 45-day over-allotment option. The offering is expected to close July 6, 2026. Proceeds fund an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment and general purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
